body.x: TwoEyes Tech(CEO Song Hun-joo, www.twoeyestech.com) is a developer of 360° VR camera that enables non-professional users to make 360° and 3D videos. Its model “TwoEyes VR” is a VR camera that can make 360° and 3D videos with one shooting. It will be introduced in CES 2017.

TwoEyes VR was made with portability and affordability in mind for non-professional users. As more people are becoming mobile-oriented, this product is taking the position as an easy 360° video maker in everyday life.

The internal battery power of this 4K binocular 360° VR camera is 1600mAh which at least gives one hour running time. When the external battery is connected, this portable camera can run to fill the internal storage capacity of 64G completely.

For the best video quality, it uses 4K processor and the image sensor of CMOS 1/2.3”. There are four lenses with F2.0 aperture that can shoot 180°. It also supports up to 3840X 3840 4K 30fps video and 8000 x 8000 pixel images.
It has Wi-Fi direct, and the images can be checked and saved on the users’ smartphones by using its app.
TwoEyes VR is compact enough to be carried around, making it perfect for one-man media that wants to produce VR contents and publish them through SNS.
It has a tripod hole so that it can be mounted on the tripod, and the pictures can be taken with either two lenses or one lens.

CEO Song Hun-joo of TwoEyes Tech said, “Most of the VR cameras that are out in the domestic and global market use one pair of lenses to take 360° images so the images didn’t really look 3-dimensional. TwoEyes Tech’s VR camera can take the 360° images just the way human beings look at the image. I am sure that people with the experience of using other cameras will have no problem operating our camera. It is a straight-line type camera that can even make 3-D videos.”
TwoEyes Tech is the VR camera manufacturer that reaches out to the users with innovative ideas and products to serve its goal to become a “global human tech company”.
